Package Application

Class Main

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
Application.Main
public class Main extends javafx.application.Application
Represents the main application class for DuckLyfe2.

This class initializes the application, manages scene transitions, tracks game statistics, and enforces parental controls. It also handles audio playback and coin generation.
Author:
Daniel Harapiak, Brandon Nguyen, Dinith Nawaratne, Zackary Goodman

    • start

      public void start(javafx.stage.Stage primaryStage)
      Starts the application and initializes the primary stage.

      This method sets up the main menu, initializes the media player for the soundtrack, and configures the persistent wrapper for global key handling.
      Specified by:
      start in class javafx.application.Application
      Parameters:
      primaryStage - The primary stage for the application.

    • setScene

      public void setScene(javafx.scene.Scene newScene)
      Sets the current scene for the application.

      This method replaces the content of the persistent wrapper with the new scene's root and enforces parental lock if active.
      Parameters:
      newScene - The new scene to set.

    • switchToPauseMenu

      public void switchToPauseMenu()
      Switches to the pause menu.

      This method stores the current scene as the previous scene and transitions to the pause menu.

    • resumePreviousScene

      public void resumePreviousScene()
      Resumes the previous scene.

      If a previous scene exists, this method transitions back to it. Otherwise, it logs a message indicating no previous scene is available.
